messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to help students get to know their new 先生 in a playful way that builds excitement and laughter from the very first moment in the 教室. Each question is designed to spark a little competition and maybe a few surprised reactions when 歓迎 turns out to be the real answer. So here are some ideas you could try with 教室 today and the students will be thrilled to learn something unexpected about the person they will 歓迎 as a new friend every single day. Let us move on to the actual questions to 学 about your new teacher. Here are some ideas you can use with your students this week. 元気 is the best way to start your first day and your students will remember it for 学校 years to come. So have fun with it and make this first day truly 楽しい and 学 something new together.

1. Your new teacher once ran a marathon. True or false?
2. Your 先生 can play the guitar. True or false?
3. Your teacher loves 音楽. True or false?
4. 学 is your favorite subject. True or false?
5. Does your teacher have a 猫 at home? 真 or false?
6. Your teacher can speak five languages. True or false?
7. Your teacher is 元気 every morning. True or false?
8. Your teacher can eat an entire pizza in one sitting. 真 or false?
9. Your teacher has a hidden talent for 音楽. True or false?
10. Your 先生 loves to 学. True or false?

So here are ten fun true or false questions for 教室 to make this new teacher introduction truly fun and memorable for every student in the room 学校.
